meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以控制浏览器，帮你打开网页、点击按钮、填写表单、截图、提取数据，还能自动完成重复操作。
howto.when: 当你要求访问网站、点击元素、填写表单、截图、抓取数据、自动化测试或登录时触发。

say.note: Claude 会打开百度并搜索天气。
Claude 会截取当前页面并保存截图。

say.text: 帮我抓取这个页面的所有文章标题
say.note: Claude 会提取页面中的文章标题列表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a browser to navigate websites, click buttons, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and automate repetitive tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to visit a website, click an element, fill a form, take a screenshot, scrape data, automate testing, or log in.

say_en.note: Claude will open Baidu and search for weather.

say_en.text: Take a screenshot of the current page
say_en.note: Claude will capture and save a screenshot.

say_en.text: Scrape all article titles from this page
say_en.note: Claude will extract the list of article titles.
